text:
Ava P. (Product): Quick sync — Acme pilot asked for ~50% lower tail latency on chat-assist (p99 target). This touches runtime kernel paths, infra prewarm, and a security review for customer data masking. Need a cross-team plan by EOD Thu. @Rajat @Maya @Liam can you call out blockers/estimates?

Rajat (Eng Runtime): Short answer: doable but non-trivial. Two parallel tracks: (1) runtime optimizations (kv-cache warm, attention kernel tweaks, quant execution path) and (2) perf config (aggressive batching + lower max_tokens). Estimate ~10 dev-days + perf runs. We need perf harness run with representative prompts.

Maya (Infra): From infra: we'll need a dedicated prewarm pool (short-lived) and a change to autoscale thresholds to avoid cold starts during peak. Rough infra work: 4 infra-days to provision + 2 days for load testing. Also need cost estimate for reserved burst capacity.

Liam (Security): Security check: customer data masking must be verified end-to-end. Confirm whether any PII flows to logs or telemetry. If so, we need a KMS/HSM key-review and redaction rules. I can do the initial review in 3 days but need sample data schema from Acme.

Ken (Eng Platform): Rollout plan suggestion: canary to 5% traffic -> monitor p50/p95/p99 + token-cost delta. Fallback policy: automatic route to current model variant on p99 spike. Also want tracing hooks added for request-id at runtime.

Ava P. (Product): Acceptance criteria (proposal): 1) p99 latency reduced by 40–60% on Acme workload, 2) no customer-visible errors during canary, 3) security sign-off on masking, 4) cost delta < 30% on tokens. Owners?

Rajat (Eng Runtime): I'll own runtime changes and perf harness runs. Checklist: 
• KV cache prewarm impl
• Kernel selection change flag
• Perf harness job + dataset link
Code sample for canary flag:
```yaml
runtime_flags:
  kernel_selector: "latency-optimized-v2"
  kv_prewarm: true
```
I'll ping when perf runs finish.

Maya (Infra): I'll own infra provisioning and autoscale tweaks. Need rough traffic curve from product (RPS & concurrency). Also: budget approval needed for burst nodes — @Ava can you confirm CSM ok? :moneybag: 

Liam (Security): I'll do masking & KMS review. Action items: get sample payloads, confirm telemetry redaction, sign-off checklist. Blocking item: if Acme requires retention exceptions we need legal ok.

Ken (Eng Platform): I'll wire the canary + fallback routing and add p99 alert thresholds. Also will add trace-id header required for tracing.

Ava P. (Product): Acme CSM confirmed sample payloads available, sending offline now. Timeline ask from Acme: pilot start in 3 weeks. Realistic?

Rajat (Eng Runtime): 3 weeks is tight but doable if we parallelize. Key risk is kernel tuning iterations — need fast feedback from perf runs. I'll split tasks across two engineers.

Maya (Infra): We can have infra provisioned in 10 days if approved today. Otherwise 3+ weeks.

Liam (Security): 3 days for initial review once sample payloads arrive. Legal dependency may add time.

Ken (Eng Platform): Canary infra + routing changes I can land in ~4 working days.

Ava P. (Product): Ok, plan:
- Today: acme sample payloads into shared drive (Ava)
- By EOD Tue: runtime perf harness job queued (Rajat)
- By Fri: infra PR for prewarm pool (Maya)
- Next Mon: security checklist draft (Liam)
- Next Wed: platform canary wiring (Ken)
- Target pilot start in 3 weeks, contingency +1 week
Owners: runtime=Rajat, infra=Maya, security=Liam, platform=Ken, product coordination=Ava.

Rajat (Eng Runtime): Acknowledged. I'll create a perf run issue and link the dataset.

Maya (Infra): Ack. I'll attach cost estimate to the infra PR.

Liam (Security): Ack. Will post checklist as a doc and tag legal if retention exceptions show up.

deploy-bot: Note: New canary route creation requires an infra ticket reference. Please add INF-4427 when you open the PR.

Ken (Eng Platform): Adding INF-4427 to my PR.

Ava P. (Product): Great — next check-in Tue morning after perf run. Thanks everyone :pray:
